To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) it is possible to uniquely establish correspondences among points in 3 frames of a sequence of weak-perspective images of a 2D object undergoing non-rigid affine motion, and (ii) this is possible in polynomial-time.

the problem of computing point correspondences from motion sequences of 3D objects undergoing nonrigid motion can be solved uniquely and efficiently, and that, the solutions can be computed in a robust fashion.
it is possible to compute the point correspondences, in a 3-frame sequence of time-variying images of an unknown object undergoing affine motion, in polynomial time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of computing correspondences in motion sequences of images of a 2D affine structure.
the problem of computing point correspondences in motion sequences of images of a nonrigid object undergoing affine motion.
the computation of point correspondences from the analysis of affine structure in motion sequences.

, the algorithms presented here are able to establish point correspondences between images of a moving 3D object in a robust and computationally efficient manner.
the algorithms presented in this paper provide a practical solution to the problem of finding point correspondences in time-varying image sequences preserving the affine structure of an object.
the algorithms presented in this paper are the first to provide a complete, practical and robust solution for computing point correspondences in motion sequences preserving affine structure.
